text.tspan: In ordinary LLM-based RAG, data originates from Legacy File Systems.
These files are directly used to construct and update the Vector Database.
The user interacts with the system.
A Query Command is issued by the user.
The Retriever performs a similarity search query against the Vector Database,
The Retriever then queries the LLM Agent with the additional retrieved context.
In SPAR, data also originates from Legacy File Systems.
The files are used to construct and update Metadata Indices.
Relevant documents from the Metadata Indices are returned to populate
The user interacts with the SPAR system.
The user issues a File Retrieval Command.
A Parser queries the Metadata Indices, returning keywords and metadata.
The user simultaneously submits a Query Command.
The Retriever queries the Vector Database and retrieves top-k documents.
Finally, the LLM Agent is queried with the additional context.
